info.title: jroc
info.description: Compiles JavaScript to .NET assemblies — install, run, done.

options.name: --input
options.description: The JavaScript file to convert (positional supported)

options.name: --moduleid
options.description: Compile an npm/CommonJS module id instead of a file path

options.name: --assemblyname
options.description: Set the assembly identity and artifact basename

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory for the generated IL (created if missing)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable diagnostics output to console

options.name: --analyzeunused
options.description: Analyze and report unused properties and methods

options.name: --pdb
options.description: Emit Portable PDB debug symbols (.pdb)

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Analyze compilation modes without writing assemblies

options.name: --json
options.description: Print coverage analysis as JSON

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information and exit

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and exit
